english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for visible glow or emitted light, including light from a hot object; the heat is usually understood from context.
This is the all-purpose noun for visible light and brightness.

examples.english: The firefly gives off a faint glow in the grass.
examples.traditional: 隻螢火蟲喺草叢入面發出微弱嘅光。
examples.jyutping: zek3 jing4 fo2 cung4 hai2 cou2 cung4 jap6 min6 faat3 ceot1 mei4 joek6 ge3 gwong1

examples.english: I pulled open the curtains, and there was light in the room right away.
examples.traditional: 我拉開窗簾，房入面即刻有光。
